story.so_that: I can add new workflows by creating a package and registering it in the orchestrator catalog without modifying existing workflow code or entangling generic infrastructure with domain behavior
story.i_want: to refactor the orchestrator package into three layers (common, orchestrator, and workflow modules) with a stable module contract

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: the start script registers all configured domains and waits for every configured Worker to poll
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the start-workflow-engine script runs When it starts the orchestrator Then it registers every configured domain and waits until all Workers report polling

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: the stop path shuts down every Worker cleanly
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the stop script runs When it shuts down the orchestrator Then every Worker context is cancelled and closed

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: generic logging identifies workflow modules and task-list-specific Workers without assuming a Story Analysis module name
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the logging implementation is moved to common When logs are emitted Then they include domain and task_list but do not hard-code story-analysis references

related_acceptance_criteria.criterion: the single-Activity diagnostic workflow remains top-level and can target Activities on each mounted task list, or its unresolved routing behavior is captured in an approved follow-up before the old path is removed
related_acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the single-Activity diagnostic workflow is implemented When it is invoked Then it can target Activities on each mounted task list or its unresolved routing is documented and approved before removal

related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given the orchestrator workflow catalog is empty When the orchestrator starts Then it reports no configured Workers and exits or idles cleanly
Given the Cadence server is not reachable When the orchestrator creates a Worker Then startup fails with a clear domain or client error

related_edge_cases.criterion: Partial Worker failure in a multi-Worker process
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given one of several Workers fails to start or crashes When the orchestrator is running Then it cancels remaining Workers and reports the failure

related_edge_cases.criterion: Single-Activity diagnostic workflow without resolved task-list routing
related_edge_cases.gherkin: Given the diagnostic workflow is started and no routing design has been chosen When it executes Then it does not silently schedule on the wrong task list and the open behavior is documented

steps.description: Update start-workflow-engine.sh to consume inspect-catalog JSON rather than duplicate catalog parsing or hard-code one domain and task list
depends_on: orchestrator inspect-catalog command and output contract

steps.description: Register every distinct configured Cadence domain and wait until each configured domain/task-list route reports a poller
Preserve one host process-group lifecycle while ensuring stop-workflow-engine.sh triggers coordinated shutdown of every Worker context before stopping Cadence
Update run-single-activity.sh and its client path to require an explicit target domain and task list and surface invalid Activity selection
Emit and consume route-aware readiness and shutdown logs without Story Analysis-specific assumptions
